quality_check: question is bounded and tied to one track
learner_action: Choose the final paper track and rewrite the question in one sentence
notes: Start from the Week 01 memo, not from a broad topic.

learner_action: Write a 4-5 sentence data description for the chosen paper
notes: Use Week 02 as a template, not as final data.

quality_check: table title, rows, columns, and N are clear
learner_action: Pick the most relevant descriptive table for the selected track
notes: A table without caption is not paper-ready.

learner_action: Summarize one cleaning decision and why it matters

quality_check: figure is readable and caption states what it shows
learner_action: Use one final figure or replace it with a later-track figure
notes: Prefer one strong figure over many weak ones.

quality_check: effect description and limitation are visible
learner_action: Keep only the statistic that directly supports the paper question

quality_check: variables map to teaching activity and rubric
learner_action: Use if the final paper is TCSOL short-course focused

quality_check: error categories are defined and counted
learner_action: Use if learner error evidence is central

quality_check: examples have clear phenomenon and teaching risk
learner_action: Use if the final paper is contrastive or teaching-material focused

notes: Do not present as statistical proof.

quality_check: metric settings and human caution are visible
learner_action: Use if the paper evaluates MT output
notes: Metrics support, not replace, human judgement.

quality_check: editing effort is linked to source type and limitation
learner_action: Use if the paper is about MTPE workflow

quality_check: metadata, date basis, coding scheme, and limitation are explicit
learner_action: Use for education-policy context or source-map method

quality_check: all cited sources have author/organization, title, date, URL, access date
learner_action: Create Zotero collection and export .bib only if using Quarto/Overleaf
notes: Word + Zotero can avoid manual .bib at first.

quality_check: sections exist: title, question, data, methods, result, limitation, references
learner_action: Draft in Word first; add citations with Zotero plugin
notes: Overleaf is optional after the prose exists.

quality_check: reader can rerun notebook and find outputs
learner_action: Write a short package README with file map and rerun note
